description.en: A rounded glass dropdown refracts a drifting flower landscape, springing between three menus with a sliding hover highlight.
description.zh: 圆角玻璃菜单折射缓慢移动的花景，在三组导航间弹簧变形，高光随选项滑动。

keywords: 玻璃 折射 导航 菜单 弹簧 色散 花景 液态 liquid glass navigation dropdown refraction Snell spectral spring jesse_vermeulen

useCases: 折射风景的玻璃导航与跨组弹簧菜单
A WebGL glass dropdown for three navigation groups
discovery.caveat: 菜单仅本地回调，不自行跳转。真实光学需要WebGL2，无GPU时保留CSS玻璃面板；HTML与照片许可未核实。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML and embedded photograph adapted to an isolated DOM/WebGL2 core with six native framework entries. Menu items emit local callbacks and never navigate or call a service by themselves.
source.license: No separate source or photograph license was supplied or verified. Inter retains its SIL Open Font License notice.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Hover or tap Product, Resources or Company. Use arrow keys to navigate and Escape to close. Menu actions remain local until connected to onAction.
instructions.zh: 悬停或点击三组导航，方向键切换选项，Esc 关闭。菜单操作为本地演示，可通过 onAction 接入业务。
